visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The camera pans across the interior of a bustling restaurant with warm wooden floors laid in a herringbone pattern. Customers are seated at several long tables, separated by acrylic dividers. In the background, a dark metal frame structure features white lettering that reads "EAT SLEEP TRAVEL" against a bright kitchen or prep area. The lighting is warm and invites a cozy dining atmosphere. (2) A close-up shot focuses on a dessert consisting of a large, golden-brown custard pudding sitting atop a mound of white shaved ice surrounded by bright orange papaya slices. A metal spoon gently presses against the top of the pudding, causing it to wobble. The scene then transitions to a dark metal hot pot filled with a vibrant orange-red broth containing glass noodles and green scallions, being stirred by a spoon. (3) The video showcases various food items in detail. Cubes of pale stinky tofu are shown in a dark ceramic bowl before being ladled into the bubbling orange soup. Another pot with a clear, boiling broth containing halves of green figs and pieces of chicken is featured. A rectangular white plate holds several thin slices of marbled red beef, which are then dipped into the hot pot with wooden chopsticks. (4) The scene displays side dishes including a bowl of white rice topped with shredded meat, gravy, and green onions. A large white platter is filled with assorted fresh vegetables like corn, mushrooms, and leafy greens. Two tall glasses of beverages—one a clear sparkling drink with a logo and the other a red fruit smoothie—are shown. Finally, thick slices of French toast sprinkled with powdered sugar and a side of cream are presented and sliced. (5) The final segment shows the exterior of the "貳堂 ERTANG HOT POT" restaurant at night. The storefront features a modern design with large glass windows and a prominent black vertical sign with white glowing characters. Text overlays providing the restaurant's address in Kaohsiung appear at the bottom of the screen as the video concludes.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A professional male narrator delivers a high-energy introduction with a fast speech rate and clear articulation. He speaks over an upbeat electronic-pop background track with a steady, synthesized beat around 120 BPM. The vocal tone is friendly and enthusiastic, with moderate pitch variability to grab the listener's attention immediately. No significant ambient noise is present, suggesting a studio-quality voice-over. (2) The narrator continues describing the spicy hot pot broth, his voice exhibiting high arousal and a positive valence. The music remains consistent, but subtle incidental sounds like the metallic clink of a spoon hitting a pot are integrated into the mix. The speech density remains high as he lists the ingredients and flavor profiles, maintaining a clear and enunciated delivery style. (3) As the focus shifts to the lighter fig chicken soup and the desserts, the narrator's tone becomes more descriptive and slightly more relaxed, though still energetic. The background music's percussive elements provide a rhythmic foundation under the continuous speech. A soft scraping sound of a knife cutting through toast is briefly audible, highlighting the textural quality of the food being discussed. (4) The audio concludes with the narrator providing the restaurant's location and a closing invitation. His voice maintains an authoritative yet inviting command, with a falling intonation at the end of the sentences. The music swells slightly before a clean hard cut, ending the track abruptly along with the voice-over.
